framing: EXPERIMENTAL stimulus model (ideal PWL source with a declared ramp time + series resistor to the cell pin); NOT a designed physical driver; loads, write pulse, initial levels and thresholds identical to #131; sweep values are ASSUMPTIONS
scope: 27 C and 125 C, tt/ss/ff/sf/fs global corners, VDD 1.8 V, no mismatch (PROPOSED range, not ratified)

rtl_trace_pins.time_base: 1 cycle = 1 ns (study assumption, not a silicon frequency claim)
rtl_trace_pins.sampling: strobes sampled 0.1 ns after each rising clock edge; zero-width delta glitches not exported

sweep_values_assumptions.note: ASSUMPTIONS; no committed driver design exists. Human review of bounds requested.

probe_definitions.snend: SN of row 0 at the FIXED gating time t_meas_fixed_ns (36 ns RTL-derived / 39 ns analog baseline = the #131 control values); never moved with the release delay, slew or R
probe_definitions.snset: SN at last-control-edge-start + 10 ns (diagnostic, not gating)
probe_definitions.snt_k: SN at last-control-edge-start + TRAJ_OFFSETS_NS[k] (diagnostic trajectory; quantized time-to-restore)
probe_definitions.pinm_pina: voltage at the CELL PIN (read-device source, node rwls_<inst>) at t_meas and at release start + 0.2 ns
probe_definitions.pins_k: cell-pin voltage at the programmed release start + PIN_OFFSETS_NS[k] (all instances)
probe_definitions.tp50r_tp90r: R = 0 and control instances only: time of the first cell-pin rising crossing of 50/90 % VDD AFTER the programmed release start (.meas WHEN RISE=1 TD=<release start>), seconds. For series-R instances the analysis interpolates linearly between the pins_k samples (None = not reached within the +32 ns window)
probe_definitions.tpa50: time of the cell-pin falling 50 % crossing (the RWL assert), seconds
probe_definitions.twf50: time of the WWL falling 50 % crossing at the WWL pin, seconds (absent for missing-write-back instances)
probe_definitions.source_edge_timing: t_src_release_start_ns (programmed edge start), t_src_release_50_ns = start + slew/2, t_src_release_end_ns = start + slew; distinct from the measured pin crossings

criteria.gating_probe: fixed (not moved with release delay, slew or R)

assumptions.loads_fixed: C_RBL, C_WBL, C_SN, 100 ohm switches, other rows' RWL (ideal VDD) are identical to #131; the driver model adds only the RWL source ramp time and a series resistor on the selected row

start_regime_check.note: delta = SN at 1.9 ns (before the RWL assert) minus the parent legacy control's; the pin_ic delta quantifies the legacy startup charge injection

restoration_only.axis: RWL release start minus WWL fall start (ns)
restoration_only.reference: d = +2 ns (the #131 rwl_late_hold release at 34 ns)

restoration_and_pin_release_90_within_bu.axis: RWL release start minus WWL fall start (ns)
restoration_and_pin_release_90_within_bu.reference: d = +2 ns (the #131 rwl_late_hold release at 34 ns)

restoration_only.axis: RWL release start minus WWL fall start (ns)
restoration_only.reference: d = +2 ns (the #131 rwl_late_hold release at 34 ns)

restoration_and_pin_release_90_within_bu.axis: RWL release start minus WWL fall start (ns)
restoration_and_pin_release_90_within_bu.reference: d = +2 ns (the #131 rwl_late_hold release at 34 ns)

restoration_only.axis: RWL release start minus WWL fall start (ns)
restoration_only.reference: d = +2 ns (the #131 rwl_late_hold release at 34 ns)

restoration_and_pin_release_90_within_bu.axis: RWL release start minus WWL fall start (ns)
restoration_and_pin_release_90_within_bu.reference: d = +2 ns (the #131 rwl_late_hold release at 34 ns)

pin_release_50_minus_wwl_fall_50_ns.definition: pin 50 % release crossing minus WWL 50 % fall

pin_release_90_minus_wwl_fall_50_ns.definition: pin 90 % release crossing minus WWL 50 % fall

restoration_vs_pin_crossing.note: association over this stimulus model only; bins are (lo, hi] in ns; the gating probe is fixed

envelope_note: Computed on the TESTED grid only: contiguous from the ideal/reference point along ONE axis; the combined points are listed, not interpolated. 'restoration_only' ignores the time budget; 'restoration_and_pin_release_90_within_budget' additionally requires the cell-pin 90 % release crossing to be <= the provisional 34 ns budget. The two are reported separately and are not the same claim.
